title: Manage people-related security across the relationship lifecycle: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Which lifecycle event changes access, evidence, or contractual control for this person or contractor?
focalInsight: Lifecycle events require proportionate, attributable approvals and verified revocation across downstream paths.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Personnel Security
nodes.decision: Match to role, access, law, lifecycle event.
nodes.failureExample: Trusted mover retains broad production access.

nodes.label: Candidate Screening
nodes.definition: Permitted pre-engagement verification relevant to role.
nodes.detail: Permitted pre-engagement verification relevant to role.
nodes.failureExample: High privilege filled without required verification.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Screening is evidence, not behavior guarantee.

nodes.label: Employment Agreement
nodes.definition: Terms for duties, confidentiality, use, IP, consequence.
nodes.detail: Terms for duties, confidentiality, use, IP, consequence.
nodes.decision: Ensure lawful acknowledgement and control alignment.

nodes.label: Onboarding
nodes.definition: Controlled entry for identity, training, equipment, access.
nodes.detail: Controlled entry for identity, training, equipment, access.
nodes.decision: Grant approved minimum access after checks.
nodes.failureExample: New hire inherits former broad groups.

nodes.label: Transfer
nodes.decision: Remove old and approve new privileges.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Transfer is grant and revoke event.

nodes.label: Termination
nodes.decision: Coordinate disable, tokens, device, hold, evidence.

nodes.label: Contractor Security
nodes.decision: Tie sponsor, duration, access, monitoring, end date.

nodes.label: Vendor Agreement
nodes.decision: Set data, incident, audit, subcontractor, exit duties.
nodes.failureExample: Supplier has no incident notice term.

nodes.label: Access Revocation
nodes.failureExample: Directory disabled but cloud token active.

altSummary: Lifecycle events require proportionate, attributable approvals and verified revocation across downstream paths.
textFallback:
personnel security: Lifecycle controls for workforce/contractor risk. Decide: Match to role, access, law, lifecycle event. Example/failure: Trusted mover retains broad production access. Retrieve: It is lifecycle governance.
candidate screening: Permitted pre-engagement verification relevant to role. Decide: Use lawful proportionate role checks. Example/failure: High privilege filled without required verification. Retrieve: Screening is evidence, not behavior guarantee.
employment agreement: Terms for duties, confidentiality, use, IP, consequence. Decide: Ensure lawful acknowledgement and control alignment. Example/failure: Discipline uses rule never communicated. Retrieve: Agreement sets expectations.
onboarding: Controlled entry for identity, training, equipment, access. Decide: Grant approved minimum access after checks. Example/failure: New hire inherits former broad groups. Retrieve: Onboarding is attributable access creation.
transfer: Role/duty change requiring access reassessment. Decide: Remove old and approve new privileges. Example/failure: Payroll transfer keeps procurement approval. Retrieve: Transfer is grant and revoke event.
termination: End engagement removal of access/property. Decide: Coordinate disable, tokens, device, hold, evidence. Example/failure: Departed admin token persists. Retrieve: Termination needs verified offboarding.
contractor security: Controls for nonemployee engagement. Decide: Tie sponsor, duration, access, monitoring, end date. Example/failure: Account outlives statement of work. Retrieve: Contractor access expires.
vendor agreement: Security/service terms for external party. Decide: Set data, incident, audit, subcontractor, exit duties. Example/failure: Supplier has no incident notice term. Retrieve: Agreement makes assurance enforceable.
access revocation: Removal of no-longer-needed permissions/tokens/devices. Decide: Verify downstream completion. Example/failure: Directory disabled but cloud token active. Retrieve: Revocation exceeds one account.

learningContract.misconception: Screening or an account disable completes personnel security.

learningContract.focalInsight: Lifecycle events require proportionate, attributable approvals and verified revocation across downstream paths.
learningContract.intentionalOmissions: Implementation settings and jurisdiction-specific conclusions are not inferred from these concise concept comparisons.
learningContract.retrievalPrompt: For a mover, leaver, or contractor, state owner, access change, evidence, and completion check.
